revision_reason: Operationalize checkpoint-separated capability curves with a preregistered normalized cadence and add a learned nuisance-only challenger on disjoint families so exact-signature balance cannot hide a generalizing higher-order shortcut.
finished_xeno_north_star: After training, reusable 0.8B-class cognitive modules must operate inside semantic Hyperposition / Global-J-Space evidence boundaries, preserve variable-N process identity, distinguish persistent DB state from simulation, cooperate with Claude Code through typed handoff/return/re-entry, and keep model output candidate/projection/measurement rather than canonical truth or direct effect authority.

measured_starting_point.interpretation_boundary: The 0.222 measurement is a small measured negative result, not proof that the 0.8B size is incapable. It can reflect capacity, objective/data design, optimization, probe sensitivity, shortcut structure, or measurement noise.

c1_preflight.purpose: Cheap information-gain gate before scaling the full mixed curriculum.
c1_preflight.time_budget: At most two hours of authorized zero-cost pilot execution when such a surface is available; this is a budget cap, not evidence by itself.
task_scope: query semantically matches the stated finite-world fact
query semantically contradicts the stated finite-world fact
query is independent/undetermined by the stated finite-world fact
c1_preflight.hyperposition_requirement: The semantic-Hyperposition carrier/schema is present from C1; only full D optimization is deferred. C1 must therefore inhabit the future Xeno operating frame instead of teaching a flat classifier that is bolted into Hyperposition later.
anti_shortcut_factorial: cross base-fact polarity positive/negative with every semantic class
cross query polarity positive/negative with every semantic class where logically possible
cross fact/query order and surface templates
family-split fantasy entities and predicates so lexical identity cannot define class
counterbalance branch order and branch IDs outside model-visible semantics
measure nuisance-only prediction on final rendered bytes

train a simple preregistered nuisance-only challenger only on TRAIN semantic-ablated model-visible inputs and evaluate it on disjoint VALIDATION nuisance families; exact-signature chance alone does not prove absence of a generalizing higher-order shortcut

checkpoint_cadence.resource_constrained_subset_rule: A smaller subset is allowed only if fixed before training and it retains baseline, at least two interior early/mid checkpoints, and final checkpoint.
checkpoint_cadence.event_triggered_extra: Optional additional saves at preregistered validation thresholds; threshold values and metric names must be frozen before training and cannot use final holdout behavior.
forbidden: select checkpoint times after opening final holdout behavior
discard a heuristic-dominant intermediate checkpoint from provenance
change cadence because an opened holdout failed

freeze_before_first_update: C1 generator identity and content hash
probe layers/token positions and probe method
behavioral metrics, permutation/null procedure, nuisance controls
checkpoint_measurements: optimizer progress fraction and checkpoint digest
three-way behavioral accuracy with per-class confusion matrix
learned nuisance-only challenger accuracy on disjoint semantic-ablated nuisance families

decision_matrix.GO: Preregistered behavioral and/or representational target signal rises beyond its frozen baseline/null on held-out families, exact and learned nuisance-only controls remain at/near their preregistered null/tolerance, and optimization/identity checks are valid.
decision_matrix.INVESTIGATE: Behavior moves without robust representation signal, representation moves without behavioral transfer, exact or learned nuisance-only prediction rises, optimization is uncertain, or positive-control behavior is inconsistent. Diagnose before scaling.
decision_matrix.NO_GO_FOR_CURRENT_08B_RECIPE: After verified optimization and clean identity/leakage checks, neither behavioral nor preregistered representation signal improves within the pilot budget and the evaluation pipeline has a functioning positive control.
decision_matrix.MODEL_SIZE_ATTRIBUTION: Do not equate NO_GO_FOR_CURRENT_08B_RECIPE with model size proven wrong. Capacity is implicated only if the same frozen C1 pipeline/recipe yields a positive control on a larger matched model or another preregistered discriminator isolates capacity from data/objective/optimization/measurement causes.

entry_requirements: C1 decision is GO or an explicitly adjudicated successor decision
A/B nuisance and rendered-byte leakage gates pass at their declared scope
positive D/E targets are derivation-bound to exact formal-world/reference-labeler identities rather than caller-asserted labels
semantic Hyperposition carrier is present in all integrated families
full_mixed_training_after_gates.training_form: One mixed curriculum/run may train A+B+C+D+E together. Staging separate full training runs is not required merely for attribution.
full_mixed_training_after_gates.instrumentation_law: At every declared checkpoint evaluate capabilities separately. One aggregate score may summarize but cannot hide a failed required channel.
full_mixed_training_after_gates.compute_accounting: This avoids extra full training runs/steps for attribution, but checkpoint holdouts and probes do consume evaluation compute. They must never be described as zero-compute.

five_core_holdouts.C: symbolic/semantic inference ladder C1-C6 with fixed semantic labels before runtime binding
five_core_holdouts.D: semantic Hyperposition branch retention/update/discriminator/resolution without collapse shortcuts
five_core_holdouts.E: GRF/epistemic typing, UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN, provenance/evidence independence, discriminator/test ordering and salience-not-truth

binding_mechanism_diagnostic.status_boundary: These labels describe the observed training trajectory only. SYSTEMATIC_BINDER_CANDIDATE requires held-out task transfer plus nuisance controls at preregistered null/tolerance; CAUSAL_BINDER_SUPPORTED additionally requires the exact model/runtime causal-intervention gate.

full_mixed_training_after_gates.failure_interpretation: A final aggregate null or regression must be localized to non-learning, shortcut learning, interference, forgetting, identity drift, or evaluation failure before changing the whole architecture/model size.

emergence_audit.goal: Test whether useful capabilities appear that were not directly target-supervised, without relabeling leakage or trained-skill composition as emergence.
freeze_before_training: rules defining direct supervision versus compositional prerequisite exposure
hard_guards: zero direct target examples for each claimed emergent capability family
no holdout selection/tuning after observing checkpoints
source ancestry disjoint from train families
model-visible nuisance predictability at null/prior under exact-signature and learned nuisance-only challengers
report compositional transfer separately from stronger emergence claims
emergence_audit.status_rule: Unexpected checkpoint improvement is EMERGENT_CANDIDATE only. Promote to a stronger claim only after explicit-training overlap, ancestry leakage, shortcut leakage and measurement artifact are excluded.

semantic_versioning.major: target semantics, label meaning, model-visible contract, split law or finished-Xeno capability objective changes
semantic_versioning.minor: new balanced families/controls preserving target semantics
semantic_versioning.patch: metadata/provenance/format/fail-closed corrections that do not change model-visible target meaning
